summary: Iteration 79 - Timeline Tracking & Before/After Photos Testing Complete. All 16 features tested and passed. Backend: 23/23 tests passed. Frontend: All UI components verified working correctly.

issue_creation_timeline.description: Issue creation includes timeline array with 'created' entry
tests: POST /api/maintenance/issues creates issue with timeline array
First timeline entry has action='created', by, at, detail fields
reported_by_email field populated with current user email
reported_by field populated with current user name
photos_before and photos_after arrays initialized as empty
PUT status=acknowledged sets acknowledged_by to current user
PUT status=in_progress sets started_by to current user
PUT status=resolved sets resolved_by to current user
PUT status=closed sets closed_by to current user
Assigning to team member creates timeline entry with action='assigned'
Unassigning creates timeline entry with 'Unassigned' in detail
Photo entry has type='before', uploaded_by, uploaded_at
Timeline entry created with action='photo_uploaded' and 'Before' in detail
Photo entry has type='after', uploaded_by, uploaded_at
Timeline entry created with action='photo_uploaded' and 'After' in detail
Comment text (truncated to 100 chars) in timeline detail

'Resolution time' calculated from created to resolved
